# opnsense_interfaces_settings (Data Source)

Reads global OPNsense interface settings.

- `dhcp6_duid` (String)

- `dhcp6_ra_timeout` (Number)
- `disable_checksum_offloading` (Boolean)
- `disable_ipv6` (Boolean)
